329:t_3:62.en:
$$マオ$$
「More likely an apology for the mistake at $$陣代高校$$. The sender called herself $$レイス$$.」

329:t_3:64.en:
$$マオ$$
「We recovered the $$サベージ$$ you used in $$ナムサク$$ too. Want us to repair it?」

329:t_3:68.en:
$$クルツ$$
(Oh... So she's his local girlfriend!)

329:t_3:69.en:
$n
(That couldn't possibly be true of $$宗介$$, could it?)

329:t_3:70.en:
$$マオ$$
($n's right. I'll get out of their way.)

329:t_3:72.en:
$$ナミ$$
「With $$ナムサク$$ in this state and the $$オーガ一家$$ wiped out, the arena can't keep running.」

329:t_3:73.en:
$$ナミ$$
「I'll be all right. Mr. $$レモン$$ says he'll hire me as his assistant.」

329:t_3:74.en:
$$宗介$$
(That's for the best... If $$アマルガム$$ notices her powers, she'll be in danger again...)

329:t_3:75.en:
$$ナミ$$
「So... take $$クロスボウ$$ with you, if it'll help at all in your battles ahead.」

329:t_3:76.en:
$$宗介$$
「...I'm sorry, $$ナミ$$. There are things I've kept from you.」

329:t_3:77.en:
$$ナミ$$
「You don't have to tell me. I've heard most of it.」

329:t_3:78.en:
$$ナミ$$
「And $$ミスリル$$ and $$アマルガム$$ don't matter. You're still you, $$宗介$$.」

329:t_3:80.en:
$$ナミ$$
「...But let me ask one thing. What are you fighting for, $$宗介$$?」

329:t_3:81.en:
$$宗介$$
「There's someone I have to save.」

329:t_3:85.en:
$$宗介$$
「I love her more than anyone.」

329:t_3:86.en:
$$ナミ$$
「I see... Then I guess there's no room for me.」

329:t_3:88.en:
$$ナミ$$
「It's all right. I was just talking to myself.」

329:t_3:89.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$ナミ$$... I'm glad I met you here in $$ナムサク$$.」

329:t_3:90.en:
$$ナミ$$
「So am I. I'll never forget the time I spent with you and Mr. $$レモン$$.」

329:t_3:91.en:
$$レモン$$
「$$ナミ$$... Shall we get going?」

329:t_3:92.en:
$$ナミ$$
「Do your best, $$宗介$$. Make sure you save that girl.」

329:t_3:98.en:
$$マオ$$
「We'd better hurry too. If we drag our feet, $$アマルガム$$ and the Empire will come after us.」

329:t_3:99.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Aaah... I wish beautiful girls would chase me like they do $$宗介$$.」

329:t_3:100.en:
$$宗介$$
「Don't get it wrong, $$クルツ$$. I'm the one doing the chasing.」

329:t_3:102.en:
$$マオ$$
「First, we'll take the plunge and cross the Pacific to regroup.」

329:t_3:104.en:
$$マオ$$
「No... Our destination is North America.」

329:t_3:105.en:
$$宗介$$
($$千鳥$$... I've found a small lead on you...)

329:t_3:106.en:
$$宗介$$
(Wait for me. I'll come for you, no matter what.)

329:t_3:110.en:
$$レナード$$
「...Have I kept you waiting?」

329:t_3:112.en:
$$レナード$$
「Your work was as efficient as ever. Though destroying $$ミスリル$$ probably made them let their guard down.」

329:t_3:113.en:
???
「I disposed of $$アマルガム$$'s key executives as you instructed.」

329:t_3:114.en:
$$レナード$$
「At the same time, I seized their network. I can now say that $$アマルガム$$ is almost entirely mine.」

329:t_3:115.en:
???
「Is there any point in sacrificing its greatest strength, its flexibility?」

329:t_3:116.en:
$$レナード$$
「The times demand speed. Besides, we will soon have no need of $$アマルガム$$ as an organization.」

329:t_3:117.en:
???
「I understand. That makes it worth having put my faith in you.」

329:t_3:118.en:
$$レナード$$
「Then let us toast our success, Major $$アンドレイ・カリーニン$$.」

329:t_3:119.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「We should be toasting the original, rightful world.」

329:t_3:120.en:
$$レナード$$
「I understand. That is our true goal, after all.」

329:t_10:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm glad you seem well too, $$ＡＧ$$.」

329:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But you were superb this time. I never thought you'd destroy three $$シャドウ$$s with a beat-up $$サベージ$$.」

329:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your fighting spirit generated 50Z in $$Ｚチップ$$s, $$宗介$$. I'll add them to the squad's stock.」

329:t_10:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「I was desperate to rescue $$ナミ$$ then. So that produced $$Ｚチップ$$s...」

329:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My, you two are quite the pair...」

329:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll report this incident when I see $$かなめ$$. The ensuing drama should generate more $$Ｚチップ$$s.」

329:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「W-What?! What is that smile that looks so out of place on you?!」

329:t_10:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$ＡＧ$$... You believe I'll see $$千鳥$$ again too.」

329:t_10:15.en:
$$宗介$$
「Thank you. I will make it happen.」

329:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(That's right, $$宗介$$. With that spirit, I'm sure you can reunite with $$かなめ$$.)

329:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(And I'm sure you'll also meet your other precious partner again...)

329:t_10:23.en:
$$マオ$$
「What's wrong, $$ＡＧ$$? Is your oil outlet clogged or something?」

329:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Don't make it sound like I'm constipated!」

329:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ouch! That was a very accurate comeback!」

329:t_10:27.en:
$$マオ$$
「So, what's wrong? If it's mechanical, Big Sis $$マオ$$ will hear you out.」
